pie: bʰréh₂ter mē tréses mē tréms swésor. h₁n̥gʷnís bʰéwdʰesi ḱwṓ-kʷe bʰéwdʰeti. kʷséps léyteti gʷémeti-kʷe sóh₂wl̥. nu h₁rṓs tinéh₁eti. nu-kʷe léwki gʷíh₃woyh₁s. swésor tr̥pyéh₁s mē tréses swésor. nu-kʷe bʰréh₂ter mē tréses.
english: Brother, do not be afraid; sister, do not tremble. Fire is awake, and the dog is awake. Night will go away, and the sun will come. Then the dew will melt. And now may you live in the light. Sister, may you be sated; sister, do not be afraid. And now, brother, do not be afraid.

pie: h₁ń̥gʷni wiHróm mē h₁éwses. nu nos mē h₁éwses wr̥h₁énn̥s. nu nos gʰórdʰom mē h₁éwses. h₁n̥gʷnís wédni ǵeǵónh₁e. nu wódr̥ gʷh₂dʰí. nu-kʷe gʷh₂dʰí wódr̥ tóm. wódr̥ tóm ḱéle wódr̥ dʰubróm h₁ésti. só Hwr̥dʰyéh₁t ǵr̥h₂nóm-kʷe h₃pusyéh₁t.
english: Fire, do not burn the man. Now do not burn our lambs. Now do not burn our hedge. Fire is born in the water. Now go to the water. And now, water, go to him. Water, cover him; the water is deep. May he become strong, and may the grain increase.

pie: tód h₁regʷesyéti sérpeti-kʷe wĺ̥kʷos. wĺ̥kʷe nos h₂ówins mē gʷr̥h₃és. nu wr̥h₁énm̥ mē gʰrébh₂s. ḱwṓ te dedórḱe séh₂gyeti-kʷe te só. n̥sméd litdʰí n̥sméd l̥gʰdʰí. h₂óweyes nos gʷíh₃woyh₁ent mē gʷr̥h₃óyh₁s tā́s. h₁yós wr̥h₁énm̥ gʷr̥h₃éti só n̥ḱyéh₁t. wĺ̥kʷe litdʰí.
english: It grows dark, and the wolf creeps. Wolf, do not devour our sheep. Now do not seize the lamb. The dog sees you, and he tracks you. Go away from us; lie down away from us. May our sheep live; may you not devour them. Whoever devours the lamb, may he vanish. Wolf, go away.

pie: h₁ń̥gʷni moy bʰréh₂tēr h₁ési. wékʷos moy wóydth₂e h₂isḱóh₂-kʷe ǵénh₁mn̥. nu moy ǵénh₁mn̥ dh₃dʰí. nu tóy lowkóy gʷíh₃woyh₁ent. tóy Hwr̥dʰih₁ént bʰh₂ih₁ént tóy téwe h₁nómn̥. ph₂sdʰí me bʰréh₂term̥-kʷe moy ph₂sdʰí. bʰebʰóydʰh₂e toy. h₁idʰí moy h₁ń̥gʷni h₁uséwōm déh₃tor gʷṓm.
english: Fire, you are my brother. You know my word, and I seek offspring. Now give me offspring. Now may they live in the light. May they become strong; may they speak your name. Protect me, and protect my brother. I trust in you. Give me cattle, Fire, giver of good things.

pie: h₂éwsos te diwés dʰúgh₂ter dedórḱh₂e. h₁rudʰréh₂ h₁ési méǵh₂ih₂-kʷe h₁ési. h₁yód nos gʷm̥yési bʰudʰént wiHrṓs. nu h₁éḱwōs sth₂ént. ǵénh₁tores moy toy kh₂nónt. nu tóybʰos ń̥dʰgʷʰitom ḱléwos déh₃s. h₁idʰí moy gʷṓm. téwe wésmn̥ h₁rudʰróm h₁ésti. mē me linékʷs. nu te léwki widóyh₁m̥.
english: Dawn, daughter of Sky, I see you. You are red, and you are great. When you come to us, the men wake. Then the horses stand up. My parents sang to you. Then you gave them imperishable fame. Give me cattle. Your garment is red. Do not leave me. Now may I see you in the light.

pie: sóh₂wl̥ téwe kʷékʷlom dedórḱh₂e. nu dʰéh₁t dyḗws kʷékʷlom sh₂wéns. h₁yód sóh₂wl̥ gʷéms h₁rṓs tinéh₁t. kéh₂nmn̥ moy ḱludʰí gʷówn̥s-kʷe moy spéḱye. nu moy h₃roǵéye póntoh₁m̥. ǵénh₁mn̥ moy téwe léwkesi gʷíh₃woyh₁t. sóh₂wl̥ néḱu ne h₁ési. nu me memn̥dʰí.
english: Sun, I see your wheel. Then Sky set the wheel of the sun. When you came, the dew melted. Hear my song, and look upon my cattle. Now make my path straight. May my offspring live in your light. Sun, you are not mortal. Now remember me.

pie: h₂éwsos toy diwés dʰúgh₂ter bʰh₂més. h₁yód h₂éwsos gʷm̥yési sth₂ént gʷówes. h₁rudʰróns nos gʷówn̥s h₂éǵe. nu nos wéyHm̥ h₂éwgmn̥-kʷe bʰére. póntoh₁m̥ nos woydéye. h₁idʰí nos ń̥dʰgʷʰitom ḱléwos. téwe nos lukéh₁ ph₂sdʰí. kéh₂nmn̥ toy moy tl̥néh₂mi. bʰebʰidʰmé toy. ǵn̥h₃ih₁mé te mē nos linékʷs.
english: Dawn, daughter of Sky, we speak to you. When you come, Dawn, the cattle stand up. Drive the red cattle to us. Now bring us strength and increase. Show us the path. Give us imperishable fame. Protect us with your light. I lift my song to you. We trust in you. May we come to know you; do not leave us.

pie: n̥bʰrós diwés gʷémt h₂wérst-kʷe ǵr̥h₂nóy. tód h₂wékst bʰréh₁wr̥h₂-kʷe pléh₁t. deywṓs n̥bʰróm widónt mudént-kʷe tóy. h₁yós ǵʰémi h₂wérst só dyḗws ph₂tḗr h₁ésti. só bʰréh₁wr̥h₂ pl̥néh₁ti móri-kʷe pl̥néh₁ti. nu nos gʷówes Hwr̥dʰih₁ént. wédʰe tóns swéh₂du wódr̥. tóy píph₃oyh₁ent tóy-kʷe tr̥pih₁ént.
english: The rain-cloud came from the sky, and rained upon the grain. It grew, and the springs became full. The gods saw the rain, and they became joyful. He who rained upon the earth is Father Sky. He fills the springs, and he fills the sea. Now may our cattle become strong. Lead them to the sweet water. May they drink, and may they be sated.

pie: ǵʰéwtōr tom h₃rḗǵm̥ wewked: "h₁yáǵeswo deywóm wérunom".
english: The priest said to the king: "Pray to the god Werunos."

pie: owis eḱwōses-kʷe
english: The Sheep and the Horses

pie: dyéw ph₂tér méǵh₂s h₁ési. h₂éwsōs twéd ǵeǵónh₁e. ǵeǵn̥h₁ḗr deywṓs twéd n̥bʰrós twéd gʷm̥yéti. téwe h₁nómn̥ ḱlutóm h₁ésti. nu nos ḱléwsesi. nu h₂stérn̥s dʰéh₁s. bʰoréyomes toy swéh₂du kéh₂nmn̥. wewórtth₂e nos. téwe léwkesi stéygʰoyh₁me.
english: Father Sky, you are great. From you Dawn is born. From you the gods are born; from you the rain comes. Your name is famous. Now you hear us. Then you placed the stars. We bring you a sweet song. You are turned toward us. May we walk in your light.

pie: kʷís h₂éwsosm̥ dedórḱe? tā́m dʰugh₂térm̥ diwés dedórḱh₂e. wéstor h₁rudʰróm wésmn̥ lowkóm tl̥néh₂ti. nu sóh₂wl̥ wédʰeti. nu-kʷe nos h₂éwsōs h₁r̥sḱé. bʰére nos wéyHm̥ léwkos nos wédʰe. nu nos h₂éwsos mē linékʷs. séh₂ HHḱéwih₂ h₁ésti séh₂-kʷe bʰebʰówdʰe. h₂éwsos n̥ḱéwih₂ ne h₁ési.
english: Who has seen Dawn? I have seen her, the daughter of Sky. She wears a red garment; she lifts the light. Then she leads the sun. And now, Dawn, go to us. Bring us strength; lead us to the light. Now, Dawn, do not leave us. She is swift, and she is alert. Dawn, you are not mortal.

pie: h₂éwsōs dʰugh₂tḗr diwés h₁ludʰét. nu bʰéwdʰt h₁n̥gʷnís. h₁ń̥gʷni bʰebʰówdʰth₂e gʷʰr̥néwsi-kʷe nos. h₂énǵʰos h₂éǵesi ish₁rós h₁ési. bʰoréyomes toy wr̥h₁énm̥ tóm-kʷe h₁édsi. nu nos téwe léwkos woydéye. bʰebʰidʰmé toy wénHs nos. nu-kʷe nos só memn̥yéh₁t.
english: Dawn, the daughter of Sky, arrived. Then Fire woke. Fire, you are alert, and you warm us. You drive away grief; you are strong. We bring you a lamb, and you eat it. Now show us your light. We trust in you; you love us. And now may he remember us.

pie: dyéw moy ph₂tér gʷówes tr̥syónti. nu moy h₂wérs h₂éǵroysu ǵn̥h₁trṓm. bʰréh₁wr̥h₂ pléh₁t h₂óweyes-kʷe mudént. nu moy ǵr̥h₂nóy h₂wérstu. dédh₃dʰi moy gʷéwbʰos wódr̥. kéh₂nmn̥ toy bʰoréyoh₂ tód ḱl̥nudʰí. ǵn̥h₃yéh₁m̥ te nu toy kh₂nṓh₂.
english: Father Sky, my cattle are thirsty. Then you rained upon the fields of my parents. The springs became full, and the sheep became joyful. Now rain upon my grain. Give water to my cattle. I bring you a song; listen to it. May I come to know you; then I will sing to you.

pie: owis eḱwōskʷe
english: The Sheep and the Horses

pie: h₁ń̥gʷni toy wr̥h₁énm̥ bʰoréyoh₂. nu h₁ddʰí tóm. wékʷos moy deywóns wéǵʰe. ǵénh₁tores moy toy h₃ósdons duh₃ént. nu toy h₃ósdons dédeh₃mi. h₁yós toy dédeh₃ti tósmey gʷṓm h₁opéye. dh₃dʰí moy ń̥dʰgʷʰitom ḱléwos. bʰebʰóydʰh₂e toy. nu moy péh₂wr̥ mē n̥ḱyéh₁t.
english: Fire, I bring you a lamb. Then eat it. Convey my word to the gods. My parents gave you branches. Now I give you branches. Whoever gives to you, give him cattle. Give me imperishable fame. I trust in you. Now may my fire not vanish.

pie: h₂ékʷeh₂es méh₂teres h₁sté. móri pl̥nh₁té tód-kʷe dʰubróm h₁ésti. wéǵʰeti wódr̥ bʰórom. bʰréh₁wr̥ pléh₁dʰeti. swéh₂du nos wódr̥ wédʰete. nu-kʷe nos h₂léksoyh₁te. mē tr̥syóyh₁me h₂ékʷeh₂es. stéygʰōmes wos. h₁yós wódr̥ píph₃eti só méwdt.
english: Waters, you are mothers. You fill the sea, and it is deep. The water carries the load. The spring is full. Lead us to the sweet water. And now may you protect us. Waters, may we not thirst. Let us walk to you. He who drinks the water is joyful.

pie: h₂éwsos diwés dʰúgh₂ter léwks. nu léytt kʷséps h₂stéres-kʷe n̥ḱént. lowkóm bʰérontih₂ h₂éwsōs póntoh₁m̥ lowkéyet. sóh₂wl̥ tā́m sékʷetor. péth₂r̥h₂ tósyeh₂s tn̥néwti. lowkós swéh₂dus tósyeh₂s h₁ésti. kʷséps swésōr tósyeh₂s h₁ésti. h₁yód nos gʷm̥yési bʰudʰént wiHrṓs. h₂éwsos nos póntoh₁m̥ woydéye. nu nos bʰréh₂tern̥s memn̥dʰí. méǵh₂ téwe ḱléwos gʷéHyomes.
english: Dawn, daughter of Sky, you grew bright. Then Night went away, and the stars vanished. Carrying the light, Dawn lit up the path. The sun follows her. She stretches her wings. Her light is sweet. Night is her sister. When you come to us, the men wake. Dawn, show us the path. Now remember our brothers. We sing your great fame.

pie: sóh₂wl̥ dʰéǵʰōm lowkéyesi. wéǵʰonti HéHḱewes h₁éḱwōs kʷékʷlom sh₂wéns. ḱludʰí me memn̥dʰí-kʷe me. h₁yós toy bʰéh₂ti tósmey lowkóm dh₃dʰí. téwe léwkm̥ widóyh₁m̥. nu moy mē tr̥mih₁ént gʷówes. bʰréh₂teres moy te widḗr. wérǵom moy r̥h₁dʰyéh₁t bʰebʰóydʰh₂e toy.
english: Sun, you light up the earth. The swift horses carry the wheel of the sun. Hear me, and remember me. Whoever speaks to you, give him light. May I see your light. Now may my cattle not tremble. My brothers know you. May my work succeed; I trust in you.

pie: deywṓs sh₂wéney ḱlutóm h₁nómn̥ dʰh₁ént. nu dʰh₁ént h₂uséy ḱlutóm h₁nómn̥. deywṓs h₁uséwōm déh₃tores h₁sénti. kʷís h₁nómn̥h₂ deywṓm wóyde? nu téh₂ widmé. deywṓs nos ḱléwsete h₂léksete-kʷe nos. deywṓs néḱewes ne h₁sénti. stéygʰōmes wos. nu nos deywṓs mē linkʷih₁ént.
english: The gods gave the sun a famous name. Then they gave Dawn a famous name. The gods are givers of good things. Who knows the names of the gods? Now we know them. Gods, listen to us, and keep us. The gods are not mortal. Let us walk to you. Now may the gods not leave us.

pie: ḱwón bʰéwdʰe ph₂sdʰí nos ḱwón h₁éḱwons. wĺ̥kʷom moréye tóy légʰyonti. nu só n̥smé mē h₁r̥sḱóyh₁t. nu mē widóyh₁t só tóns. h₁yós h₁éḱwons h₂lékseti h₁n̥gʷnís tóm h₂léksoyh₁t. tóy h₃pusih₁ént. ḱwón bʰéwdʰe ḱwón nos h₁éḱwons ph₂sdʰí.
english: Dog, be awake; dog, protect our horses. Kill the wolf; they lie down. Now may he not come to us. Now may he not see them. Whoever guards the horses, may Fire guard him. May they increase. Dog, be awake; dog, protect our horses.

pie: dyéw nos ph₂tér wékʷos ḱludʰí. nu dʰéh₁s bʰréh₁wr̥h₂. h₁ógʷʰim gʷʰéns h₂ékʷeh₂es-kʷe h₁n̥dʰént. h₁uséwōm déh₃tōr h₁ési. wóydth₂e nos wénHs-kʷe nos. nu nos kʷís n̥bʰróm déh₃t? só dyḗws h₁ésti. nu dʰéǵʰōm swéh₂du wódr̥ péh₃t. ḱlutóm téwe h₁nómn̥ gʷéHyomes. wéyHm̥ nos h₂éwgmn̥-kʷe bʰére. nu nos memn̥dʰí wérǵom nos r̥h₁dʰyéh₁t.
english: Father Sky, hear our word. Then you placed the springs. You slew the serpent, and the waters came forth. You are the giver of good things. You know us, and you love us. Who then gave us the rain? He is Sky. Then the earth drank the sweet water. We sing your famous name. Bring us strength and increase. Now remember us; may our work succeed.

pie: kʷís kʷékʷlom sh₂wéns dʰéh₁t? dyḗws-ge tóm dʰéh₁t. wéǵʰonti HéHḱewes h₁éḱwōs tóm. deywṓs tóm dedr̥ḱḗr. só ish₁rós h₁ésti só-kʷe HéHḱus h₁ésti. nu kʷékʷlom sh₂wéns gʷéHyōmes. só nos wewórte só néḱus ne h₁ésti. nu-kʷe nos h₂lékse tóh₁.
english: Who set the wheel of the sun? Sky indeed set it. The swift horses carry it. The gods see it. It is strong, and it is swift. Now let us sing the wheel of the sun. It is turned toward us; it is not mortal. And now protect us with it.

pie: dʰéǵʰom méh₂ter bʰórom bʰoréyesi. bʰéresi nos h₂élesi-kʷe nos. séh₁mn̥ ǵʰémi h₂wékst tód-kʷe Hwérdʰt. h₂wérst n̥bʰrós swéh₂du-kʷe wódr̥ péh₃s. méh₂tēr deywṓm h₁ési nu nos ḱléwse. téwe psténm̥ srobʰéyomes. h₁opéye nos h₂léh₁wr̥ wéyHm̥-kʷe. h₂éǵros dʰugʰyéh₁t.
english: Mother Earth, you bear the load. You carry us, and you nourish us. The seed grew in the earth, and it became strong. The rain-cloud rains, and you drink the sweet water. You are the mother of the gods; now hear us. We sip at your breast. Give us flour and strength. May the field be productive.

pie: nu péh₂wr̥ h₃ósdoy ḱéytor. gʰrébh₂t wiHrós h₃ósdom péh₂wr̥-kʷe h₁nédʰt. h₁ń̥gʷni wódr̥ gʷʰr̥néwsi. h₃ósdōd dʰégʷʰeti. nu pékʷesi wr̥h₁énm̥. bʰréh₂tēr nos h₁ési ǵénh₁tōr-kʷe nos h₁ési. h₁n̥gʷnéy sdmé tósmey-kʷe h₃ósdom duh₃mé. wékʷos nos ḱléwsonts h₁n̥gʷnís léwkt. nu tód mē n̥ḱyéh₁t.
english: Now fire lies in the branch. The man seized the branch, and fire came forth. Fire, you heat the water. The branch burns. Then you cook the lamb. You are our brother, and you are our parent. We sat down by Fire, and we gave him a branch. Listening to our word, Fire grew bright. Now may it not vanish.

pie: dyḗws dʰéǵʰōm-kʷe ǵénh₁tores deywṓm h₁sénti. dyḗws ph₂tḗr h₁ésti dʰéǵʰōm-kʷe méh₂tēr h₁ésti. deywṓs diwés ǵʰmés-kʷe ǵeǵn̥h₁ḗr. tóy ish₁rṓs h₁sénti tóy-kʷe ḱlutṓs h₁sénti. ḱluté nos dyéw ph₂tér dʰéǵʰom méh₂ter. tóy bʰebʰudʰḗr. nu nos h₂éwgmn̥ h₁opéyete. tóy nos wn̥Hént. nu nos h₃pusih₁ént gʷówes.
english: Sky and Earth are the parents of the gods. Sky is the father, and Earth is the mother. From Sky and Earth the gods are born. They are strong, and they are famous. Father Sky and Mother Earth, hear us. They are alert. Now give us increase. They love us. Now may our cattle increase.

pie: ń̥bʰre diwés h₁ludʰés h₂wérs-kʷe ǵʰémi. dʰéǵʰōm péh₃t bʰréh₁wr̥h₂-kʷe pléh₁t. nu móri wédn̥s pléh₁t. h₁yós téwe wódr̥ píph₃eti só méwdt. nu-kʷe nos wéǵʰe wódr̥. séh₁mn̥ h₃pusyéh₁t deywṓs-kʷe mudih₁ént. n̥bʰrós HéHḱus h₁ésti nu toy gʷéHyomes.
english: Rain-cloud, you came from the sky, and you rained upon the earth. The earth drank, and the springs became full. Then the sea became full of water. Whoever drinks your water becomes joyful. And now convey the water to us. May the seed increase, and may the gods be glad. The rain-cloud is swift; now we sing to you.

pie: dʰéǵʰom h₂ówins h₂élesi. ḱéytor swéh₂dus h₁rṓs téwe h₂éǵroy. gʰórdʰos ǵʰelh₃wós h₁ésti. sóh₂wl̥ h₁rósm̥ gʷʰr̥néwti ǵr̥h₂nóm-kʷe h₂wékst. kʷís nos h₂életi? h₂életi nos. séh₂ h₁uséwōm déh₃tōr h₁ésti. h₁yós h₂éryeti só h₁édti. nu Hwr̥dʰyéh₁t séh₁mn̥. séh₂ nos wénHt nu nos memn̥dʰí.
english: Earth, you nourish the sheep. The sweet dew lies on your field. The hedge is green. The sun warms the dew, and the grain grows. Who nourishes us? She nourishes us. She is the giver of good things. He who ploughs eats. Now may the seed become strong. She loves us; now remember us.
